typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		logicCount as integer,
		tradeCount as integer,
		SOR as string,
		RiskRating as string,
		logic as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromtblY14TradeTestingStage1a
fromtblY14TradeTestingStage1a sink(input(
		logicCount as integer,
		tradeCount as integer,
		SOR as string,
		RiskRating as string,
		logic as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		logicCount,
		tradeCount,
		SOR,
		RiskRating,
		logic),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblY14TradeTestingLogicStage1
